entry.title: My Father No.4 Lancero — Single
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, dark chocolate, bourbon or dark rum
entry.summaryHtml: Black pepper, cedar, espresso, cocoa, leather and sweet cherry define the original My Father lancero. The Habano-Rosado wrapper keeps the 38-ring smoke aromatic and spice-forward, while the all-Nicaraguan core builds roasted nuts, baking spice and substantial nicotine across the long format.
entry.noteHtml: Cigar Hut lists the exact 7.5″ × 38 My Father No.4 Lancero single at A$56.
